frontendChange: P6 development installs bounded String support in the unified registry and lowers String literals/primitive equality to checked finite-domain Core v71 K3-TB. P6.1 canonicalizes equivalent portable Lean escape spellings before assigning Core constructors so "A", "\x41", and "\u0041" share semantic identity across Core, Lean export, and TypeScript. P6.2 adds literal-only `++` constant folding before Core lowering, so safe concat examples become ordinary checked String literals while non-literal/runtime append remains fail-closed. P6.3 adds literal-only `String.length` folding to Nat for decoded portable literals and folded concat outputs while non-literal/runtime length remains fail-closed. P6.7 adds literal-only `String.utf8ByteSize` folding to Nat for decoded portable literals and folded concat outputs while non-literal/runtime byte-size queries remain fail-closed. P6.4 adds literal-only `String.isEmpty` folding to Bool for decoded portable literals and folded concat outputs while non-literal/runtime String predicates remain fail-closed. P6.5 adds literal-only `String.startsWith` and `String.endsWith`, folding decoded portable literal operands and folded concat outputs to Bool while runtime predicate APIs remain fail-closed. P6.6 adds literal-only `String.contains`, folding decoded portable literal operands and folded concat outputs to Bool while runtime predicate APIs remain fail-closed. P6.8 adds literal-only `String.append` function folding and permits existing literal-only String consumers such as `String.length` and `String.contains` to consume nested folded String.append outputs while runtime/non-literal append remains fail-closed. P6.9 adds literal-only `String.take` and `String.drop`, folding decoded portable String operands plus literal/foldable Nat counts to checked bounded String constructors; runtime/non-literal subjects or counts remain fail-closed. P6.10 adds literal-only `String.takeRight` and `String.dropRight`, folding decoded portable String operands plus literal/foldable Nat counts to checked bounded String constructors; runtime/non-literal subjects or counts remain fail-closed. P6.11 adds literal-only `String.beq`, folding decoded portable literal operands and nested folded String values to checked Bool constructors while runtime/non-literal String.beq calls remain fail-closed. P6.12 adds literal-only `String.isPrefixOf`, folding decoded portable literal operands and nested folded String values to Bool with Lean-compatible prefix-first argument order while runtime/non-literal String.isPrefixOf calls remain fail-closed. P6.13 adds literal-only `String.stripPrefix` and `String.stripSuffix`, folding decoded portable literal operands and nested folded String values to checked bounded String constructors while runtime/non-literal strip calls remain fail-closed. P6.14 adds literal-only `String.isNat`, folding decoded portable literal/folded String values to Bool with the supported Lean decimal Nat syntax boundary while runtime/non-literal String.isNat calls remain fail-closed. P6.17 adds a K3-TB default-kernel consistency guard that rejects stale current/default Core v68 wording and package/provenance version drift while preserving v71 K3-TB as the practical kernel.
